subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should this PR land the narrow fresh-session recook fallback now, or pause so accepted disconnects are redesigned around reattaching to the in-flight gateway run first?
rationale: The patch fixes same-session transcript duplication, but the accepted-disconnect path can still execute a second local run and possible second delivery, which is a user-visible behavior tradeoff rather than a purely mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Land Narrow Fix
options.body: Accept the same timeout-style fallback boundary for this rare disconnect path and track reattach-first recovery separately.

options.title: Expand Before Merge
options.body: Ask the contributor to turn this PR into the reattach-first design so accepted disconnects prefer the authoritative gateway run before any local recook.

options.title: Pause For Follow-Up Decision
options.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge until maintainers decide the product behavior in the related recovery issue.

recommendation.title: Land Narrow Fix
recommendation.body: Accept the same timeout-style fallback boundary for this rare disconnect path and track reattach-first recovery separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest direct history signal for the CLI gateway-agent command and its tests points to this area contributor.
